name: SEN12MS
description: A dataset of paired Sentinel-1 synthetic-aperture radar and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery with land-cover labels, designed for multi-modal land-cover mapping and remote-sensing research.
citation: Schmitt et al., SEN12MS: A Curated Dataset of Georeferenced Multi-Spectral Sentinel-1/2 Imagery for Deep Learning and Data Fusion, ISPRS Annals of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences, 2019.

license.notes: Refer to the upstream dataset distribution for applicable access and usage terms.
